description: Status and tracking for the paid order belonging to this job. Use it after payment (hip_get_checkout_status says paid, or hip_complete_payment succeeded); before payment it answers PAYMENT_PENDING, so use hip_get_checkout_status while waiting. Returns order_id and status, plus tracking_number and tracking_url once a shipping label exists (a First-Class letter has no tracking).

job_handle.description: the job_handle that hip_create_job returned (job_ followed by 32 hex characters). Only the API key that created the job can use it.

name: hip_get_order
title: Get order status and tracking
